title: Men’s & Women’s Body Grooming in Midtown Toronto
summary: Professional body grooming for men and women in Midtown Toronto, with back, torso, arms, legs, full-body grooming, body scrubs, facials and private appointment planning.
intro: Professional grooming should feel clear, comfortable and unhurried. Tell our team the result you want, the areas you would like groomed and any skin sensitivities. We will confirm the right appointment length, preparation and price before you arrive.
sections: A simple way to plan your grooming visit

Body grooming is personal, so clear communication matters. You do not need to know every detail before contacting us. Tell our team whether you are interested in back, torso, arms, legs, full-body grooming, or a combination with massage, body scrub or facial care. We will help plan a comfortable appointment with clear boundaries and professional aftercare.
Back Grooming
For guests who want a cleaner, smoother back with careful preparation and aftercare.
Chest & Torso Grooming
A professional grooming option for the chest and torso, planned around skin sensitivity and desired finish.
Arms & Legs Grooming
Targeted grooming for arms, legs, or both, with preparation and aftercare appropriate to the skin.
Full-Body Grooming
A longer appointment for guests who want multiple body areas groomed in one visit.
Grooming + Spa Care
Combine grooming with a body scrub, facial or massage when you want a more complete spa visit.
What to share before your appointment
The areas you would like groomed.
Any sensitive skin, irritation, recent shaving, waxing or skin treatments.
Whether you prefer fragrance-free or extra-gentle products.
Whether you are pairing grooming with massage, a body scrub or facial.
Any areas you would like the attendant to avoid.
Do you offer body grooming for men and women?
Yes. V Spa offers professional body-grooming options for men and women. Tell our team which areas you would like groomed so we can confirm the right timing and price.
Can I combine grooming with a massage?
Yes. Grooming may be paired with a suitable massage appointment. A longer booking is usually more comfortable when adding multiple services.
Can I add a body scrub or facial?
Yes. Body scrubs and facials can be added when timing allows. Our team will confirm the total appointment length before your visit.
Is the appointment private?
Yes. Treatments are provided in private rooms. Share any comfort preferences or areas to avoid when booking so expectations are clear before the appointment.
What should I do before a grooming appointment?
Avoid irritating the skin immediately beforehand, and tell our team about sensitivity, recent skin treatments or any areas that should be avoided.

sections: Choose your massage

Choose a 30, 45 or 60 minute massage for a shorter reset or a slower full-body visit. Share your preferred pressure and focus areas with our team. The Luxury 4-Hand Hot Stone & Oil Ritual is provided by two therapists treating one guest.
Add skincare or body grooming

Body scrubs, facials, back grooming, full-body grooming and other professional body-grooming options can be paired with a suitable appointment. Tell our team which areas you would like groomed so preparation, timing and price can be confirmed.
Plan a longer spa visit

The Spoil Me Package is $349 per person for 2.5 hours. It includes a 45-minute Swedish or deep tissue massage, a 20-minute body scrub, a body-grooming add-on or a 20-minute facial, a 30-minute foot massage, singing bowl, hot stone and a relaxing finishing ritual.
Book with clear expectations

Call, text or send an appointment request with your preferred time, treatment and any add-ons. Our team will confirm availability, total appointment length and final price before your visit. An appointment request is not a confirmed reservation.
Private rooms and professional care

Treatments take place in private rooms. Share comfort preferences, skin sensitivities and any areas to avoid before your appointment. You can ask to adjust pressure, pause or stop a treatment at any time.
Visit V Spa in Midtown Toronto
Find us at 525 Eglinton Ave W, Second Floor. We are open daily from 10 AM to 9 PM. Call or text 647-857-1226 to confirm availability before travelling.
